node_definition.done_when: Done when a test writes a delivered plan review's staging record after its run has promoted, and finds the record in the committed store. A record written before promotion is committed once, by the promotion, as today. The negative control restores the promotion-only guard, and the late record then stays staged. The manifest names the pass that wrote the record late. The test files importing the modules changed add no failure against a base arm. Both arms come from git checkouts under the run's own scratch directory, with the four follower variables unset, and run in place on the fleet node with pytest -n 8 . Every log is under the run directory, starts with its revision and the literal command, and ends in EXIT= . ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings. Write paths: reckon/crew/promotion.py , the module the manifest names as the late writer, and the new test.
